description: Vorbehaltsgebiet Hochwasserschutz (Risikobereich)/Überschwemmungsbereich is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Principle in the regional plan, with which the existing flood risk in already built-up flood areas is to be taken into account in planning and measures. Source of data:- Regional Planning Association Upper Lusatia/Lower Silesia with legal basis Regional Plan, 1. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flood protection reserve (risk area)/flood area" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vorbehaltsgebiet, Risikobereich, Grundsatz, vorbeugend, Freiraum, Regionalplan. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
